conflict.ctd: Simple Combat Bar is standing down because Carousel Combat Tracker (combat-tracker-dock) is also active. Both draw a turn-order bar across the top of the screen; disable one of them in Manage Modules.

enabled.name: Show the Combat Bar
enabled.hint: Show the turn-order bar across the top of the screen during combat. Only affects you.

portraitStyle.name: Portrait Style
portraitStyle.hint: How each combatant is drawn on the bar.

portraitSize.name: Portrait Size
portraitSize.hint: The largest a portrait is drawn, in pixels. With Fit to Width on, portraits shrink below this when the bar is crowded. Only affects you.

overflow.name: When the Bar Is Full
overflow.hint: What happens when there are more combatants than fit across the screen. Only affects you.

portraitImage.name: Portrait Image
portraitImage.hint: Use the actor's portrait art or the token's image.

nameVisibility.name: Combatant Names
nameVisibility.hint: When players see the names of combatants they don't own or observe. The GM always sees names.

choices.token: When the token's name is shown on hover or always
choices.owner: Only for combatants they own or observe

hpVisibility.name: Hit Points
hpVisibility.hint: How much players see of the hit points of combatants they can't observe. Foundry doesn't send the hit points of unlinked tokens to players who can't observe them, so for those the bar shows how wounded they are from their Bloodied and Dead conditions instead.

choices.all: Everyone sees exact hit points (when Foundry shares them)
choices.owner: Others see only healthy / bloodied / badly wounded

damageFill.name: Fill Portraits With Damage
damageFill.hint: Portraits fill red from the bottom as hit points are lost. Follows the Hit Points setting: exact for those who may see hit points, in coarse steps for those who only see how wounded a combatant is.

hpBar.name: HP Bar Under Portraits
hpBar.hint: Show a hit point bar under each portrait, for those allowed to see hit points. Turn it off if the red damage fill is enough.

hideEnemyInitiative.name: Hide Enemy Initiative
hideEnemyInitiative.hint: Players don't see initiative values for combatants they don't own.

initiativeDialog.name: Initiative Roll Window
initiativeDialog.hint: Who gets the roll window (advantage, disadvantage, situational bonus) when they press a portrait's d20. Hold Shift or Ctrl on the d20 to skip it, as elsewhere in D&D 5e.

hideUnseenFirstRound.name: Reveal Enemies as They Act
hideUnseenFirstRound.hint: In the first round, players only see a hostile or neutral combatant on the bar once it has taken its turn.

hideDefeated.name: Remove Defeated Combatants
hideDefeated.hint: Take defeated combatants off the bar instead of showing them greyed out.

trackEconomy.name: Action Pips
trackEconomy.hint: Show Action, Bonus Action and Reaction on the current combatant's card, and each combatant's Reaction on theirs. Shown to the GM and to those who can see the creature's sheet; the owner and the GM can click a pip to flip it.

autoSpendEconomy.name: Spend Pips Automatically
autoSpendEconomy.hint: Using an ability spends the pip its activation needs. Pips come back at the start of each combatant's turn. With midi-qol active, midi-qol does this itself and the pips follow it.

legendaryBadges.name: Legendary Badges
legendaryBadges.hint: Show a legendary creature's legendary actions and resistances left on its card, for the GM and those who can see its sheet. Click one to spend it, Shift-click to give it back. D&D 5e spends and refills them itself as they're used.

showEffects.name: Status Effect Icons
showEffects.hint: Show each combatant's status effects on their card, as their token shows them on the map, with a ring for the duration left. The owner or GM can right-click an icon to remove it.

effectDescriptions.name: Effect Descriptions in Tooltips
effectDescriptions.hint: Who sees each effect's description when hovering a portrait. Everyone sees the effect names.

choices.owner: The GM and those who can see the creature's sheet

groupTeams.name: Group Turns
groupTeams.hint: Like Baldur's Gate 3: allies or enemies next to each other in the order share one frame. With group turns, they also share one turn: any of them can act, in any order, by clicking their portrait, and the turn moves on once all of them have ended theirs.

choices.visual: Shared frame, still one at a time

sidebarOnCombat.name: Sidebar When Combat Starts
sidebarOnCombat.hint: Collapse the sidebar when combat starts, to give the scene more room.

xpSummary.name: XP Summary When Combat Ends
xpSummary.hint: When the GM ends a combat, whisper them a card listing the defeated enemies and their total XP, with an Award button.

trackers.name: Trackers
trackers.label: Configure Trackers
trackers.hint: Add a second bar under each portrait, and choose the values shown when hovering one.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Write the bar's internal events to the browser console. Only affects you.

fields.name: Name
fields.initiativeHint: Where it takes its turn. Use a decimal, such as 19.5, to place it between two combatants.
fields.durationHint: It's removed at the start of the round after this many rounds. Leave blank to keep it until you remove it.
fields.arrivesRoundHint: Leave blank for now. Until then it's hidden from players and its turns are skipped, and its duration counts from that round.
fields.hiddenHint: Players won't see it on the bar until you reveal it.

errors.name: Give the event a name.
errors.initiative: Give the event an initiative number.
errors.duration: Duration must be a whole number of rounds, or blank.
errors.arrivesRound: The arrival round must be a whole number, this round or later.

arrivals.title: When Does {name} Arrive?
arrivals.arrived: {name} arrives, and is revealed to the players.

fields.roundHint: Until then it's hidden from players and its turns are skipped. It's revealed when its turn comes up in that round.

errors.round: The round must be a whole number, {round} or later.

trackers.title: Configure Trackers
trackers.label: Label
trackers.secondaryHint: A second bar under each portrait's hit points, for a resource with a maximum: legendary actions, spell slots, a class resource. Like hit points, it's shown only to those who can see the creature's sheet.
trackers.tooltipHint: Shown when hovering a portrait, to the GM and to those who can see the creature's sheet. Pick an attribute from the list or type its path; leave the label blank to show the path.

legendary.actionsTooltip: Legendary Actions: {value} of {max} left. Click to spend one, Shift-click to give one back.
legendary.resistancesTooltip: Legendary Resistances: {value} of {max} left. Click to spend one, Shift-click to give one back.

groupTurns.noGM: A GM needs to be connected to change turns within a group.
groupTurns.failed: The GM's client didn't respond, so the turn didn't change. Try again.
